propositions: When an LLM call is blocked by a content policy (Bedrock Guardrail or Anthropic refusal), the operator message incorrectly says 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the guardrail/content-filter block.
The resolution_class CHANGE_INPUT is correct for both content-filter blocks and genuine size/malform cases, so reclassification is not the fix — only the message text must change.
message_for() must accept an optional finish_reason parameter and return a distinct message when resolution_class=CHANGE_INPUT and finish_reason=content_filter.
The finish_reason value is already available on LLMOutcome.diagnostic and persisted coverage diagnostic and must be threaded through all three render call sites.
Backward compatibility must be preserved: message_for() called with only resolution_class must return the generic message; the resolution_class, retryable flag, and exit code are unchanged.
